youtube.title: OKX Referral Code: What It Unlocks and How to Enter It (2026)
youtube.description:
The OKX referral code is a short code you type once when you create your account. It links your new account to the person who invited you and can make you eligible for the current new user rewards.

Referral code: XOACPQFC

In this video you'll see what an OKX referral code does, where to enter it during OKX sign-up, and three checks to run first: whether OKX is available where you live, using only the official app, and reading the rewards terms. We also cover why you should turn on two-factor authentication on day one.

FAQ
What does the OKX referral code do?
It links your new account to a referrer at registration. Your account, fees and security settings work the same way as any other account.
When do I enter the OKX referral code?
During sign-up, in the referral or invite code field, before you finish registration. Adding a code later is not always possible.
How much is the OKX new user reward?
Offers change and can differ by country. The current welcome rewards and their terms are shown in the app's rewards page.

Updated: November 2026
